entities.summary: Lysander Spooner was an American abolitionist, entrepreneur, lawyer, essayist, natural rights legal theorist, pamphleteer, political philosopher, and writer often associated with the Boston anarchist tradition. Lysander Spooner was a performers & entertainers from Athol (1808-01-19, Athol–1887-05-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
